verdict.rationale: Visa's Purchase Intent API (POST /acp/v1/instructions) lets an agent create a documented, mandate-scoped order object with merchant, amount and decline-threshold fields, and the agent-toolkit exposes tools to 'create and manage payment links and invoices' — both function as order-draft-like protocol calls, but neither is framed as a generic cart with line-item update semantics. Missing for 10: an explicit cart/line-item CRUD API, ability to update quantities/items post-creation, and independent hands-on confirmation of cart-style usage.
